The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally calls `_unflatten_snapshots` for snapshot-indexed arrays attached to a network, without checking semantics or the option. For an array whose snapshot coordinate is a flat object index of `(period, timestep)` tuples with matching auxiliary coordinates, this replaces that index with a MultiIndex before conversion to pandas; the base version does not perform this conversion. Thus the returned index can differ even under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`.
